Date: 2027-04-01T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-on pricing questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood’s visibility suite. A few quick pricing questions from our side as we build the business case:

- Retention: what are the price breakpoints for 30 / 90 / 365 days? Any option for rollover credits on snapshot retention?
- Tracing: you mentioned per-million spans pricing in the deck. Can you share the per-MSP (million spans) bands for 0-10M, 10-100M, >100M?
- Dashboards: is advanced dashboards billed per-seat or a flat add-on? Any discounts for embedding multiple dashboards across teams?

We’re looking at a pilot (Q3) and if the economics work we’d like an enterprise 12–24 month proposal. Procurement is cc’d (procurement@streamlytics.com) for timing.

Best,
Alyssa

VP Engineering | Streamlytics

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you. Appreciate the clear asks. Summary below, attaching a simple pricing model and SOW stub for an initial commercial frame (see attachments).

High-level options (list pricing, illustrative only):
- Retention (per-GB/month): 30d = $0.015/GB; 90d = $0.025/GB; 365d = $0.055/GB.
  - Option: 90d default for pilot, upgrade to 365d with compression & tiering.
  - Rollover: we can offer limited rollover credits (up to 10% of committed storage) on annual committed tiers.
- Tracing (spans): 0–10M = $4.00 per MSP; 10–100M = $3.00 per MSP; >100M = $2.25 per MSP.
- Advanced dashboards: base platform includes 2 dashboards. Advanced package = flat $2,500/month for up to 15 dashboards + $125/dashboard beyond that OR seat-based option at $60/seat/month if you prefer per-user licensing.

Discounting and commitment:
- Standard pilot: month-to-month for 3 months with startup credits (2 months free on retention up to 10TB).
- Enterprise: 12-month commitment qualifies for 12–15% discount (sliding scale based on ARR commit).

Ask: if Streamlytics can share a 12-month committed spend range, I can run an internal pricing exception for deeper discounting. Also confirm whether you prefer seat-based dashboards or flat bundle.

I’ve attached RI-pricing-model-observability.xlsx for the arithmetic. If helpful I can route a slightly altered credit/rollover proposal via the pricing team.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement and engineering: 

- Discount: Streamlytics is aiming for ~20% off list for a 12-month commitment. Can Redwood do 20% if we commit to a $150k ARR minimum for the observability add-on?
- Rollover: 10% rollover is a start — procurement is asking for 25% rollover on committed retention for the first year (we often have bursty months).
- Tracing: we will likely be in the 10–100M spans band. Can the per-MSP for that band be $2.50 (vs $3.00 listed)?
- Dashboards: we prefer the flat bundle (vendor-managed dashboards) but want the ability to add embedded dashboards later. Will there be a migration cost?

If you can get close on the three asks above we can move procurement forward this week. Procurement contact is Lisa Moreno (procurement@streamlytics.com).

Best,
Alyssa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Observability add-on pricing questions — Streamlytics counter

Team — forwarding Streamlytics’ asks. Quick summary and recommendation:

- They asked for 20% discount on list for a $150k ARR commit; 25% rollover on retention; tracing band 10–100M at $2.50/MSP.
- They prefer flat dashboard bundle and want embeddable dashboards later (low migration complexity, mostly front-end work + config).

My proposed path:
- Offer 18% discount on 12-month, $120k ARR committed observability add-on. If they bump to $180k ARR we’ll do 20% and 25% rollover credits for year 1.
- For tracing, we can move the 10–100M band to $2.65/MSP as a commercial concession (not standard list).
- Keep dashboard pricing as flat bundle with a one-time embed enablement fee (TBD, lean technical assist).

Can pricing/legal confirm we can accept 25% rollover for year 1 as a limited concession (and include explicit roll-over mechanics in the SOW)? Also need approval for the $2.65 trace concession and authority to push 20% at $180k.

Looping Jordan and Karthik for decision. Marissa, please confirm any CS onboarding cost implications for the embed enablement so we can bake into SOW.

Thanks,
Kimberly
